head: Where do you get
your protein?
name: Dr. Michael Klaper
end_cta: Find Dr. Michael Klaper on|Vegans Explore

captions.text: "If you're not eating meat, where are you getting your protein?"
But again, ask any buffalo, ask any giraffe, ask any muskox.
These animals grow to thousands of pounds of mammalian muscle
without ever eating a cheeseburger or pepperoni pizza.
The real protein powerhouses are the whole grains
and the legumes, beans, peas, chickpeas, lentils.
You eat whole plant food, three solid meals,
you eat 1,800, 2,000 calories of whole plant foods,
you are guaranteed of getting more than enough protein.
